name: vitruvian-roborock-mcp
description: Check on and control a Roborock vacuum: status, live map, start, pause, dock and mop wash.

args: command -v rrctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "vitruvian-roborock-mcp: rrctl is not on your PATH. Install it: https://github.com/VitruvianSoftware/vitruvian-roborock-mcp#quick-installation" >&2; exit 127; }; exec rrctl mcp
